blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Water: Complete Training Edition (Part 1)

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives — Part A
blocks.en: Learning Objectives — Part A

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈1231〉 的教育性目的及其在製藥用水管理中的定位
blocks.en: Understand the educational purpose of USP <1231> and its place in pharmaceutical water management

blocks.zh: 區分 Bulk Monographed Waters（PW、WFI、WFH、Pure Steam）與 Sterile Monographed Waters 的異同
blocks.en: Distinguish between Bulk Monographed Waters (PW, WFI, WFH, Pure Steam) and Sterile Monographed Waters

blocks.zh: 掌握 Source Water 的品質要求及其對下游純化系統的影響
blocks.en: Understand the quality requirements for source water and their effect on downstream purification systems

blocks.zh: 了解各類非典藥水（Non-Monographed Waters）的定義與應用場景
blocks.en: Know the definition and typical applications of the various non-monographed waters

blocks.zh: 能夠判斷不同藥品製程應選用何種等級的製藥用水
blocks.en: Be able to decide which grade of pharmaceutical water a given drug manufacturing process should use

blocks.zh: Section 1 — Introduction 簡介
blocks.en: Section 1 — Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: USP 〈1231〉 是一個「資訊性章節」（informational chapter），而非強制規格章節。它的目的是教育製藥業人員如何選擇、生產、驗證和監控製藥用水，同時指引讀者參考各個水的專論（monograph）以取得具體的規格要求。
blocks.en: USP <1231> is an "informational chapter", not a chapter with mandatory specifications. Its purpose is to educate pharmaceutical industry personnel on how to select, produce, validate, and monitor pharmaceutical waters, and to refer readers to the individual water monographs for the specific requirements.

blocks.zh: 水在製藥中的角色包括：
blocks.en: The roles of water in pharmaceutical manufacturing include:

blocks.zh: 原料（raw material）— 製劑成分
blocks.en: Raw material — a component of the formulation

blocks.zh: 非活性賦形劑（inactive ingredient）— 溶媒、賦形
blocks.en: Inactive ingredient — solvent, vehicle

blocks.zh: 清洗用途（cleaning）— 設備、容器清潔
blocks.en: Cleaning — cleaning of equipment and containers

blocks.zh: 分析試劑（analytical reagent）— 測試用途
blocks.en: Analytical reagent — testing purposes

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: USP 〈1231〉 明確列出四項使用者責任：選擇適當等級的水、符合政府法規、符合藥典規格、符合測試要求。這四點是查廠時 FDA/PMDA 審查員常用的評估框架。
blocks.en: USP <1231> explicitly lists four user responsibilities: selecting the appropriate grade of water, meeting government regulations, meeting compendial specifications, and meeting testing requirements. These four points are a framework that FDA/PMDA inspectors often use during inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 可以把 USP 〈1231〉 想成一本「製藥用水百科全書」，告訴你各種水的特性、如何生產、如何驗證、如何監控。而各個水的「monograph」（如 Purified Water、Water for Injection）才是「法規標準」，規定了具體合格規格。兩者相輔相成：〈1231〉提供知識背景，monograph 提供考試答案。
blocks.en: Think of USP <1231> as an "encyclopedia of pharmaceutical water" that tells you the characteristics of each water, how it is produced, how it is validated, and how it is monitored. The individual "monographs" (such as Purified Water and Water for Injection) are the "regulatory standards" that set the specific acceptance specifications. The two complement each other: <1231> provides the background knowledge, and the monograph provides the answers to the exam.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果一個公司的 SOP 只引用 〈1231〉 而沒有引用 WFI monograph，這樣的水管理系統是否完整？
blocks.en: If a company's SOP cites only <1231> and does not cite the WFI monograph, is that water management system complete?

blocks.zh: 清洗用水（cleaning water）和製劑用水（formulation water）可以用同一等級嗎？
blocks.en: Can cleaning water and formulation water be of the same grade?

blocks.zh: Section 2 — Source Water Considerations 原水考量
blocks.en: Section 2 — Source Water Considerations

blocks.zh: 原水（Source Water）是整個製藥用水系統的起點。USP 〈1231〉 要求：所有用於藥品製造的水，其原水來源最低必須符合「飲用水標準」（drinking water standards）。
blocks.en: Source water is the starting point of the entire pharmaceutical water system. USP <1231> requires that the source water for all water used in drug manufacturing must, at a minimum, meet "drinking water standards".

blocks.zh: 國際認可的飲用水標準來源：
blocks.en: Internationally recognized sources of drinking water standards:

blocks.zh: 美國：US EPA NPDWR（40 CFR 141）
blocks.en: United States: US EPA NPDWR (40 CFR 141)

blocks.zh: 歐盟：EU Drinking Water Directive
blocks.en: European Union: EU Drinking Water Directive

blocks.zh: 日本：日本厚生勞動省飲用水基準
blocks.en: Japan: Drinking water standards of the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

blocks.zh: 國際：WHO Drinking Water Guidelines
blocks.en: International: WHO Drinking Water Guidelines

blocks.zh: 原水就像製藥原料一樣，必須先通過基本的「進料品管」（incoming quality control）。如果原水品質差，後續的純化設備就需要更大的「除污能力」，增加系統複雜度和失效風險。這就像用劣質麵粉做麵包——再好的烘焙技術也難以補救基本原料的問題。
blocks.en: Like any pharmaceutical raw material, source water must first pass basic "incoming quality control". If the source water quality is poor, the downstream purification equipment needs greater "contaminant removal capacity", which increases system complexity and the risk of failure. It is like baking bread with poor-quality flour: even the best baking technique can hardly compensate for a problem with the basic raw material.

blocks.zh: 私有供水（非市政供水）的廠商需要自行驗證原水符合飲用水標準。這在亞洲部分地區的 CDMO 工廠特別重要——如果工廠使用井水或自建蓄水設施，必須定期取樣並測試，不能假設品質穩定。
blocks.en: Companies with a private water supply (non-municipal) must verify by themselves that the source water meets drinking water standards. This is especially important for CDMO sites in parts of Asia: if a site uses well water or its own water storage facilities, it must sample and test regularly and must not assume the quality is stable.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌製劑廠房設計時，原水品質監控應納入水系統驗證計畫（Water System Validation Plan）。建議至少每季採樣一次市政水，分析微生物計數、重金屬、TOC、導電度等關鍵指標，並記錄於水系統日誌中，以供 FDA 查廠時展示對原水變異的主動管理能力。
blocks.en: When designing a sterile drug product facility at a CDMO, source water quality monitoring should be built into the Water System Validation Plan. We recommend sampling municipal water at least once per quarter and analyzing key indicators such as microbial counts, heavy metals, TOC, and conductivity, and recording the results in the water system logbook, so that you can demonstrate to FDA inspectors that you proactively manage source water variability.

blocks.zh: Section 3 — Waters Overview: Bulk Monographed Waters 藥典散裝用水
blocks.en: Section 3 — Waters Overview: Bulk Monographed Waters

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 水的分類
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Classification of Waters

blocks.zh: 製藥用水的分類邏輯：
blocks.en: The classification logic for pharmaceutical waters:

blocks.zh: Bulk Monographed Waters（散裝藥典水）：現場生產、即時使用的高品質水，包括 PW、WFI、WFH、Pure Steam
blocks.en: Bulk Monographed Waters: high-quality waters produced on site and used immediately, including PW, WFI, WFH, and Pure Steam

blocks.zh: Sterile Monographed Waters（無菌藥典水）：預先包裝並滅菌的水，如 Sterile PW、Sterile WFI、BWFI 等
blocks.en: Sterile Monographed Waters: waters that are pre-packaged and sterilized, such as Sterile PW, Sterile WFI, and BWFI

blocks.zh: Non-Monographed Waters（非藥典水）：有特殊用途描述的水，無正式規格，如 Deionized Water、Distilled Water 等
blocks.en: Non-Monographed Waters: waters with a descriptive use but no formal specification, such as Deionized Water and Distilled Water

blocks.zh: PW vs WFI 關鍵差異 Key Differences
blocks.en: Key Differences: PW vs WFI

blocks.zh:
特性                 Purified Water (PW)    Water for Injection (WFI)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
主要用途              非注射製劑、清洗          注射製劑、內毒素控管
Endotoxin 規格        無                    必需（≤0.25 EU/mL）
生產方式              DI / RO / Dist.        蒸餾 or 等效方法（USP）
Biofilm 風險          高（常溫系統）           需主動控制
導電度規格             ≤1.3 µS/cm (25°C)     ≤1.3 µS/cm (25°C)
TOC 規格              ≤500 ppb              ≤500 ppb
blocks.en:
Characteristic        Purified Water (PW)    Water for Injection (WFI)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Main use              Non-parenteral products, cleaning    Parenteral products, endotoxin control
Endotoxin limit       None                   Required (≤0.25 EU/mL)
Production method     DI / RO / Dist.        Distillation or equivalent method (USP)
Biofilm risk          High (ambient systems) Needs active control
Conductivity limit    ≤1.3 µS/cm (25°C)     ≤1.3 µS/cm (25°C)
TOC limit             ≤500 ppb              ≤500 ppb

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — WFI 的嚴格性
blocks.en: Analogy — Why WFI Is Stricter

blocks.zh: WFI 和 PW 的關係，就像「手術室用水」和「病房清潔用水」的差異。兩者都要乾淨，但手術室用水多了一個絕對不能有的東西：內毒素（endotoxin）。內毒素即使在水很純的情況下也可能存在（因為它是細菌的殘骸），所以 WFI 系統必須從設計上主動移除它，光靠化學純度測試是不夠的。
blocks.en: The relationship between WFI and PW is like the difference between "operating room water" and "ward cleaning water". Both must be clean, but operating room water has one more thing that must be absolutely absent: endotoxin. Endotoxin can be present even when the water is very pure (because it is the debris of bacteria), so a WFI system must be designed to actively remove it. Chemical purity testing alone is not enough.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — PW 的 Biofilm 風險
blocks.en: Key Notes — Biofilm Risk in PW

blocks.zh: USP 特別強調：常溫（ambient）PW 系統比 WFI 系統更容易形成生物膜（biofilm）。這是因為 PW 系統通常不需要熱水循環（hot loop），無法用溫度抑制微生物生長。因此 PW 系統的消毒頻率和微生物監控要求更高，且監控數據必須根據歷史趨勢設定 Alert Level 和 Action Level。
blocks.en: USP specifically emphasizes that ambient PW systems form biofilm more readily than WFI systems. This is because PW systems usually do not use a hot loop, so temperature cannot be used to suppress microbial growth. PW systems therefore require more frequent sanitization and more rigorous microbial monitoring, and the monitoring data must be used to set Alert Levels and Action Levels based on historical trends.

blocks.zh: 一個注射劑廠的設備清洗用水，必須使用 WFI 還是 PW？依據是什麼？
blocks.en: For cleaning equipment at an injectables plant, must WFI or PW be used? What is the basis for the answer?

blocks.zh: 若工廠只有 PW 系統，可以用 PW 洗注射容器嗎？
blocks.en: If a plant has only a PW system, can PW be used to wash injectable containers?

blocks.zh: WFI 的 endotoxin 規格 0.25 EU/mL 是哪裡來的？如何在系統設計上確保達標？
blocks.en: Where does the WFI endotoxin limit of 0.25 EU/mL come from? How do you ensure it is met in the system design?

blocks.zh: Section 3.1.3–3.1.4 — Water for Hemodialysis & Pure Steam 血液透析用水與純蒸汽
blocks.en: Section 3.1.3–3.1.4 — Water for Hemodialysis & Pure Steam

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 血液透析用水的特殊性
blocks.en: Key Concepts — What Makes Hemodialysis Water Special

blocks.zh: Water for Hemodialysis（WFH）是所有散裝水中唯一有明確微生物限度（microbial limit）規格的水。這是因為透析療程中，患者的血液直接透過薄膜與透析液接觸，微生物污染可能直接引起全身性感染。因此 WFH 的品質標準接近 WFI，但又稍有不同（不要求注射用途）。
blocks.en: Water for Hemodialysis (WFH) is the only bulk water with an explicit microbial limit specification. This is because during dialysis the patient's blood is in direct contact with the dialysate across a membrane, so microbial contamination can directly cause systemic infection. The quality standard for WFH is therefore close to that of WFI, but slightly different (it is not intended for injection use).

blocks.zh: Pure Steam vs Plant Steam — 關鍵區別
blocks.en: Pure Steam vs Plant Steam — Key Differences

blocks.zh: 這是查廠常見的考點：
blocks.en: This is a frequent inspection topic:

blocks.zh: Pure Steam（純蒸汽）：接觸產品或產品接觸面時使用。必須符合藥典規格，冷凝液需通過 WFI 化學測試（有時還需通過 〈85〉 endotoxin 測試）
blocks.en: Pure Steam: used when the steam contacts the product or product-contact surfaces. It must meet compendial specifications, and the condensate must pass the WFI chemical tests (and sometimes the <85> endotoxin test as well)

blocks.zh: Plant Steam（工廠蒸汽）：僅用於非產品接觸設備的滅菌或加熱，通常含有防腐添加劑（anticorrosion additives），不得接觸產品
blocks.en: Plant Steam: used only for sterilizing or heating non-product-contact equipment. It usually contains anticorrosion additives and must not contact the product

blocks.zh: 誤用 Plant Steam 接觸產品是嚴重的 GMP 違規，可能導致抑菌劑或腐蝕添加劑污染產品。
blocks.en: Misusing Plant Steam where it contacts the product is a serious GMP violation, and may contaminate the product with bacteriostatic agents or anticorrosion additives.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — Pure Steam 的重要性
blocks.en: Analogy — Why Pure Steam Matters

blocks.zh: Pure Steam 就像「食品級不鏽鋼」和「工業用不鏽鋼」的差異：外表看起來都是蒸汽，但工廠蒸汽裡可能添加了防鏽劑（就像工業鋼材含有對食品有害的成分）。無菌製劑廠的高壓蒸汽滅菌器（autoclave）必須使用 Pure Steam，確保滅菌後的器材不帶有有害殘留物。
blocks.en: Pure Steam versus Plant Steam is like "food-grade stainless steel" versus "industrial stainless steel": both look like steam, but plant steam may contain anti-rust additives (just as industrial steel may contain components that are harmful to food). The autoclaves in a sterile manufacturing facility must use Pure Steam to ensure the sterilized items carry no harmful residues.

blocks.zh: 在無菌 CDMO 的設施設計中，Pure Steam 系統通常與 WFI 系統共用純化設備（同等品質的水源），並單獨設置蒸汽產生器（pure steam generator）。Pure Steam 冷凝液的定期測試（至少每年一次）是 FDA 查廠的檢查重點，測試項目包含：不揮發性殘留物（non-volatile residue）、導電度、pH、endotoxin（若用於 parenteral 相關用途）。
blocks.en: In the facility design of a sterile CDMO, the Pure Steam system usually shares purification equipment with the WFI system (feed water of equivalent quality) and has its own pure steam generator. Periodic testing of Pure Steam condensate (at least once a year) is a focus of FDA inspections. The tests include non-volatile residue, conductivity, pH, and endotoxin (if used for parenteral-related purposes).

blocks.zh: Section 3.2 — Sterile Monographed Waters 無菌藥典水
blocks.en: Section 3.2 — Sterile Monographed Waters

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 無菌水的特殊性
blocks.en: Key Concepts — What Makes Sterile Waters Special

blocks.zh: 無菌水（Sterile Monographed Waters）和散裝水（Bulk Waters）最大的差別在於：無菌水的化學純度標準較寬鬆，因為包裝材料會釋放有機物和無機物到水中，且這種釋放會隨時間增加。因此，不能假設無菌水和散裝水同等純淨。
blocks.en: The biggest difference between Sterile Monographed Waters and Bulk Waters is that the chemical purity standards for sterile waters are less strict, because the packaging material releases organic and inorganic substances into the water, and this release increases over time. You therefore cannot assume that a sterile water is as pure as a bulk water.

blocks.zh: 五種無菌水的比較：
blocks.en: Comparison of the five sterile waters:

blocks.zh: Sterile PW：非注射用，PW 來源
blocks.en: Sterile PW: for non-parenteral use, PW as the source

blocks.zh: Sterile WFI：注射稀釋，≤1 L 單劑量
blocks.en: Sterile WFI: for dilution of injections, single-dose containers of ≤1 L

blocks.zh: BWFI：含防腐劑，多劑量用，≤30 mL
blocks.en: BWFI: contains a preservative, for multiple-dose use, ≤30 mL

blocks.zh: Sterile Water for Irrigation：>1 L 容器，不要求 〈788〉顆粒物
blocks.en: Sterile Water for Irrigation: containers of >1 L, <788> particulate matter not required

blocks.zh: Sterile Water for Inhalation：吸入用，endotoxin 要求較寬
blocks.en: Sterile Water for Inhalation: for inhalation use, with less stringent endotoxin requirements

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 包裝容器的影響
blocks.en: Key Notes — Effect of the Packaging Container

blocks.zh: 無菌水的化學規格寬鬆的根本原因：玻璃容器會釋放鈉離子（影響導電度），塑膠容器會釋放有機物（影響 TOC）。USP 允許這些浸出物存在，但設定了相應的容器體積相關規格（見 Section 00b 的 TOC 容器體積表）。這就是為什麼在分析實驗室，如果要做精確的離子色譜（Ion Chromatography），應該使用現場生產的 PW，而非從瓶裝無菌水取樣。
blocks.en: The fundamental reason the chemical specifications for sterile waters are less strict: glass containers release sodium ions (affecting conductivity), and plastic containers release organic substances (affecting TOC). USP allows these leachables but sets corresponding container-volume-dependent limits (see the TOC container volume table in Section 00b). This is why, in an analytical laboratory, if you need to perform precise ion chromatography you should use PW produced on site, not a sample taken from bottled sterile water.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — BWFI 的防腐劑
blocks.en: Analogy — The Preservative in BWFI

blocks.zh: BWFI 含有防腐劑（通常是苯甲醇 benzyl alcohol 或苯扎氯銨 benzalkonium chloride），就像「含防腐劑的生理食鹽水」。多劑量瓶每次打開都有污染風險，防腐劑的作用是防止微生物在多次使用間繁殖。但正因如此，BWFI 不適用於不能接受防腐劑的情況（如新生兒注射），這是 BWFI 的應用限制。
blocks.en: BWFI contains a preservative (usually benzyl alcohol or benzalkonium chloride), much like "physiological saline with preservative". A multiple-dose vial carries a contamination risk every time it is opened, and the preservative prevents microbial growth between uses. For the same reason, BWFI is not suitable where preservatives cannot be accepted (such as injections for neonates), which is a limitation of its application.

blocks.zh: 一個醫院配藥室配製大量靜脈注射液，應使用 Sterile WFI 還是散裝 WFI？從法規和成本角度各是什麼考量？
blocks.en: A hospital pharmacy compounds large volumes of intravenous solutions. Should it use Sterile WFI or bulk WFI? What are the regulatory and cost considerations for each?

blocks.zh: Sterile Water for Irrigation 可以用於注射稀釋嗎？為什麼不行？
blocks.en: Can Sterile Water for Irrigation be used to dilute injections? Why not?

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 接受委託製造注射劑時，如果客戶要求在 API 重組（reconstitution）時使用特定等級的水，必須確認其所指的是 Sterile WFI（容器包裝）還是散裝 WFI（water system）。這影響到原料採購、供應商管理和品質協議（Quality Agreement）的內容。特別注意：若使用無菌水替代散裝水，需要先進行適用性評估（fitness-for-use assessment）。
blocks.en: When a CDMO accepts contract manufacturing of an injectable and the client requires a particular grade of water for API reconstitution, it must confirm whether the client means Sterile WFI (packaged in containers) or bulk WFI (from the water system). This affects raw material purchasing, supplier management, and the content of the Quality Agreement. Note in particular: if sterile water is used in place of bulk water, a fitness-for-use assessment must be performed first.

blocks.zh: Section 3.3–3.4 — Drinking Water & Non-Monographed Waters 飲用水與非藥典水
blocks.en: Section 3.3–3.4 — Drinking Water & Non-Monographed Waters

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 非藥典水的定位
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Where Non-Monographed Waters Stand

blocks.zh: 非藥典水（Non-Monographed Waters）是描述性名稱，不等同於正式的 USP 規格。在 USP 文件中出現的「deionized water」、「distilled water」等名稱，不代表這些水符合任何特定規格——它們只是描述了製備方法或某些屬性。
blocks.en: Non-Monographed Waters are descriptive names and are not equivalent to a formal USP specification. Names such as "deionized water" and "distilled water" that appear in USP documents do not mean that these waters meet any particular specification; they merely describe the method of preparation or certain attributes.

blocks.zh: 重要原則：當 USP 測試方法或試劑配製中出現「water」一詞而無其他說明時，一律視為 Purified Water。
blocks.en: Important principle: when the word "water" appears in a USP test method or reagent preparation without further qualification, it is always taken to mean Purified Water.

blocks.zh: 高純水導電度規格 High-Purity Water Conductivity
blocks.en: High-Purity Water Conductivity

blocks.zh:
High-Purity Water（高純水）規格：
  NMT 0.0556 µS/cm = NLT 18.0 MΩ·cm at 25°C

用途：Ion Chromatography 〈1065〉
      Plasma Spectrochemistry 〈1730〉

注意：高純水一旦接觸大氣，CO₂ 溶入後
      導電度立即上升約 1.0 µS/cm
      因此必須密閉使用或現製現用
blocks.en:
High-Purity Water specification:
  NMT 0.0556 µS/cm = NLT 18.0 MΩ·cm at 25°C

Uses: Ion Chromatography <1065>
      Plasma Spectrochemistry <1730>

Note: once high-purity water is exposed to the atmosphere,
      dissolved CO₂ raises the conductivity
      by about 1.0 µS/cm immediately,
      so it must be used in a closed system or made fresh and used immediately

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — BET 用水的特殊要求
blocks.en: Key Notes — Special Requirements for BET Water

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素測試（BET/LAL test）用水是所有水中最嚴格的——不僅要化學純，還必須確定無內毒素干擾（endotoxin-free）。製備方式：PW 或 WFI 加熱至 70°C 持續 30 分鐘以降解內毒素，或直接購買已驗證無內毒素的 Sterile WFI（LAL Reagent Water）。錯誤使用含內毒素的水做 BET 測試，會導致偽陰性結果，這是嚴重的品質失誤。
blocks.en: Water for bacterial endotoxins testing (BET/LAL test) is the most demanding of all waters: it must not only be chemically pure but also be confirmed endotoxin-free (no endotoxin interference). It is prepared by heating PW or WFI at 70°C for 30 minutes to degrade endotoxin, or by purchasing Sterile WFI that has been validated as endotoxin-free (LAL Reagent Water). Using water that contains endotoxin for a BET test leads to false-negative results, which is a serious quality failure.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 去離子水的誤解
blocks.en: Analogy — The Misconception About Deionized Water

blocks.zh: 很多人以為「去離子水」（DI water）就等於「純水」或「WFI」，這是錯誤的。去離子只移除了離子性污染物，但無法移除有機物、微生物和內毒素。就像「過濾掉鹽巴的海水」不等於「礦泉水」——去除鹽分只是純化的一個步驟，不是全部。
blocks.en: Many people think "deionized water" (DI water) is the same as "pure water" or "WFI", which is wrong. Deionization removes only ionic contaminants; it cannot remove organics, microorganisms, or endotoxin. It is like saying "seawater with the salt filtered out" is the same as "mineral water": removing the salt is only one step of purification, not the whole process.

blocks.zh: 實驗室分析師在配製 HPLC 流動相時，標準作業程序上寫「使用 water」，應取用哪一種水？
blocks.en: A laboratory analyst is preparing an HPLC mobile phase and the SOP says "use water". Which water should be used?

blocks.zh: 若工廠的 PW 系統臨時故障，可否暫時使用去離子水（DI water）替代？需要做哪些確認？
blocks.en: If a plant's PW system fails temporarily, can deionized water (DI water) be used as a temporary substitute? What confirmations are needed?

blocks.zh: BET 測試失敗（rabbit test 陽性），首先應檢查哪些水相關因素？
blocks.en: If a BET test fails (positive rabbit test), which water-related factors should be checked first?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section A Summary
blocks.en: Section A Summary

blocks.zh: USP 〈1231〉 是教育性資訊章節，搭配各水的 monograph 一起使用；最低水質要求「water」= Purified Water
blocks.en: USP <1231> is an educational, informational chapter that is used together with the monograph for each water; the minimum water quality requirement: "water" = Purified Water

blocks.zh: Source Water 最低須符合飲用水標準（US EPA NPDWR / EU / JP / WHO）；私有供水需自行驗證
blocks.en: Source water must at a minimum meet drinking water standards (US EPA NPDWR / EU / JP / WHO); a private water supply must be verified by the user

blocks.zh: Bulk Monographed Waters：PW（非注射）、WFI（注射 + endotoxin 控制）、WFH（透析 + 微生物限度）、Pure Steam（接觸產品表面）
blocks.en: Bulk Monographed Waters: PW (non-parenteral), WFI (parenteral + endotoxin control), WFH (dialysis + microbial limit), Pure Steam (product-contact surfaces)

blocks.zh: Sterile Waters 的化學規格較散裝水寬鬆，因包裝材料浸出物；不可假設無菌水和散裝水等純
blocks.en: The chemical specifications for Sterile Waters are less strict than for bulk waters because of leachables from packaging materials; do not assume sterile waters are as pure as bulk waters

blocks.zh: BWFI 含防腐劑，多劑量使用；Sterile Water for Irrigation 容器可 >1 L，不要求 〈788〉
blocks.en: BWFI contains a preservative and is for multiple-dose use; the container for Sterile Water for Irrigation may be >1 L, and <788> is not required

blocks.zh: Deionized Water 不等於 PW 或 WFI；高純水導電度要求 ≤0.0556 µS/cm；BET 用水必須確認無內毒素
blocks.en: Deionized Water is not equivalent to PW or WFI; high-purity water must have conductivity ≤0.0556 µS/cm; BET water must be confirmed endotoxin-free

blocks.zh: Plant Steam vs Pure Steam：前者不得接觸產品，後者用於產品直接接觸的蒸汽滅菌和加濕
blocks.en: Plant Steam vs Pure Steam: the former must not contact the product; the latter is used for steam sterilization and humidification where the steam directly contacts the product
